title: Holicraft
description: This Project Adds Realistic Milk & Cookies To Your Game
body:
This is a pretty simple resource pack. Ever seen any of those youtube shorts with realistic food? Love them textures? Well now you can do that with GOD156's very own Milk & Cookies resource pack!

Also the discord is not dedicated to this resource pack. It is used for other things too. Please ping the owner and clearly state you're there for the resource pack. Report bugs and make suggestions in the discord. 😉
